'''Shane Watner Slim On Cloud City''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Shane Watner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5326">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5326 Slim On Cloud City], DeckTech (Shane "Outlaw" Watner, 11 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5326/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5326/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022111956/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5326/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shane Watner]]
* '''Published:''' 11 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Slim On Cloud City''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor SOCC Watner LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mains on CC with a little bit o' retrieval.

== Original post ==

'''Slim On Cloud City'''
* '''Author:''' Shane "Outlaw" Watner
* '''Published:''' April 11, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mains on CC with a little bit o' retrieval.

=== Strategy ===

Start CP against everything but HDADTJ. Then use Goo. Other than that, it is pretty straight forward.
